previous_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY captured_eur_minor) FROM v_payment_intent WHERE eventually_approved
question: cuál es el importe por debajo del cual está el noventa por ciento de los pagos
sql: SELECT captured_eur_minor FROM (SELECT captured_eur_minor, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY captured_eur_minor) as rank_pct FROM v_payment_intent WHERE eventually_approved) WHERE rank_pct <= 0.9 ORDER BY captured_eur_minor DESC LIMIT 1
